user.title: Add Nanoleaf light
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Nanoleaf device.

data_description.ip_address: IPv6 address of the device (ULA preferred, e.g. fd00::...). Found via mDNS or your router.
data_description.model: Device model from the label or mDNS. Required for NL45/NL55/NL58/NL62 (legacy key derivation).

pair.title: Pair Device

data_description.pairing_code: Code from the device label. NL67 and newer: 11-digit (e.g. 3394-532-2503). NL45 and older: 8-digit (e.g. 1234-5678). Dashes are optional.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The access token for **{name}** was rejected. Enter the pairing code again to re-pair.

data_description.pairing_code: Code from the device label. NL67 and newer: 11-digit (e.g. 3394-532-2503). NL45 and older: 8-digit (e.g. 1234-5678). Dashes are optional.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to device. Check the address and that the device is reachable.
error.invalid_pin: Pairing failed. Check the pairing code and that the device is not already paired to another controller.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.
